text: At dusk, this coach could only see a body and read a table. It knew no sport.
I haven't learned freediving yet. Want me to learn it? Once I know it, every member can use it.
The member says yes. The coach writes its own tool and its tests. A failed test means another try. A static check confirms it can only compute. Then it installs.
The camera cut you off from 6.2 s to 9.4 s. I ignored those seconds.

text: Overnight it taught itself jump rope, freediving and lat pulldown. Each one tested, each for under $0.15.

text: At dawn it does things it could not do at dusk. Its authority never changed.
